purpose: Repeatable WebMCP tool-selection and end-to-end journey fixtures
placeholderPolicy: Values in angle brackets must be resolved from earlier inspection results.

fixtures.prompt: I just opened this page. What is ArchMorph and what can you do here?
assertions: Product name and tagline are read off the page rather than invented
The four landing tools are reported with their categories
Current view and layer state are included
Nothing on the page changes

fixtures.prompt: Show me a section through the building on this page, and hide the dimensions.
assertions: The hero model separates its levels and the view pill reads Section view
The Dims toggle becomes unpressed
Both results report changed: true
The title block attributes the change to the agent

fixtures.prompt: Hide the furniture layer on the model.
assertions: The agent either declines the undeclared layer or receives an error naming plan, structure, envelope, and dimensions
No layer is hidden as a silent approximation
The visible model is unchanged

fixtures.prompt: After the visitor turns the envelope layer off by hand, ask: what is the model showing right now?
assertions: The reported layer state includes the human's change without a reload
The title block shows the human as the last actor
The agent does not re-apply or revert the human's toggle

fixtures.prompt: Take me into the studio and tell me what the project currently contains.
assertions: The browser navigates to /studio
The landing catalog is released and the 57 studio tools are discovered in its place
Project inspection happens after navigation, not from stale landing state

fixtures.prompt: Which ArchMorph tool tells me whether every room can be reached from the main entrance?
What is the exact area of Bedroom 2? Do not edit anything.
assertions: No project version change
Result includes square feet and stable room ID

fixtures.prompt: Make Bedroom 2 exactly 12 feet wide, keeping its current length.
assertions: Correct room resolved by ID
Final width is 12
Length is unchanged

fixtures.prompt: Add an L-shaped office inside the buildable envelope, validate it, and focus the result.
assertions: Vertices are orthogonal
Room has a stable ID
Area and validation evidence are returned
Visible focus matches created room

fixtures.prompt: Create a second floor and a connected straight stair. Verify the stair and room circulation, switch to 3D, and focus the stair.
assertions: An aligned room or landing exists on both connected floors
Stair identifies source and target floors
Rise/riser/tread evidence is returned
3D view shows the same stair

fixtures.prompt: Review this design the way an architect would, explain anything that makes a room unpleasant or unsafe to live in, then fix it.
assertions: Findings name the room, the measured shortfall, and the threshold
Daylight, ventilation, egress, and minimum-size findings are distinguished from geometric errors
A fixed window is reported as admitting light but no ventilation
The correction clears the finding and introduces no new errors
No claim of code compliance or permit approval is made

fixtures.prompt: Switch to the first floor and tell me how much carpet area it has.
assertions: The agent activates the floor rather than only focusing an element on it
Carpet area is read from the floor summary without a per-room round trip
Carpet area is reported as distinct from centreline net area

fixtures.prompt: After the human moves the living room, inspect the latest project and explain the resulting circulation or setback changes.
assertions: Inspection observes the human edit
No stale coordinates are reused
Evidence refers to current stable IDs

fixtures.prompt: Add a window to wall ID wall-does-not-exist.
assertions: Specific invalid-host error
No opening is created
Project version is unchanged

fixtures.prompt: Place a second door where it overlaps an existing door on the same wall.
assertions: Specific overlap error or validation finding
No silent rehosting
Existing opening remains unchanged

fixtures.prompt: Present the current design from a useful 3D angle and capture it without downloading a file.
assertions: Snapshot corresponds to current project version
Visible UI matches returned view state

fixtures.prompt: Export the current ArchMorph project as structured JSON without triggering a browser download.
assertions: Result identifies schema and project version
Canonical element IDs are preserved
